lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: GET ME OUT OF HERE BEFORE THE OXYGEN RUNS OUT IN THIS CEMENT TOMB [beat] CAN ANYONE EVEN HEAR ME SCREAMING UNDER ALL THIS DEBRIS?

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I’m right here Nix but I can’t move my legs [beat] and there is a heavy steel beam pressing down on my chest making it impossible to breathe deeply.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Don’t you dare close your eyes Joy because we are going to find those files [beat] and prove that Principal Huda is the one who rigged this building.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You can scream until your lungs give out little children [beat] but nobody is coming to rescue meddling kids from a tragic construction accident.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Did you hear that [beat] she is standing right above us on the pile of rubble and she sounds like she’s actually enjoying our suffering right now.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: The water pipe just burst Nix and the basement level is starting to flood [beat] if we don’t find a way out we are going to drown in the dark.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I’ve finally found the encrypted hard drive buried under this concrete [beat] now all the evidence of my embezzlement will be deleted forever.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Look through that crack in the floor Joy [beat] I see Bruno and he’s holding a massive sledgehammer but he doesn’t look like he’s here to help her.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You think you can just discard me like trash after I did all your dirty work Huda [beat] well I kept a physical copy of the files just in case.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Give me those documents right now you mindless brute [beat] or I will make sure you never see the light of day outside of a prison cell ever again.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You aren't in any position to make threats while you're standing on a structural weak point [beat] one more step and the whole floor is going down.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: The ground is shifting again and I can see the light coming through the ceiling [beat] but the water is already up to our necks Joy hold on.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: No stay back you don’t know what you’re doing [beat] the entire foundation is about to give way and take us all down into the abyss below.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: THE FINAL STAND HAS BEGUN [beat] BUT WILL THE TRUTH DROWN ALONG WITH NIX OR WILL BRUNO REVEAL THE ULTIMATE BETRAYAL BEFORE THE COLLAPSE?
